name: Pickup run
summary: Plan the run to pick up something big: whose car it fits in, which time most people are free, and who lifts.
useWhen: something bought on Marketplace needs picking up: 'who has a car for the couch', 'we need two people to carry it'
a few friends' cars, a couple of times, a route
dontUseWhen: people riding to an event (use carpool)
splitting what the item cost (use split-purchase)
deciding whether to buy it (use group-buy)

params.title: e.g. 'Couch pickup run'
params.sub: item and catch, e.g. '84″ couch · 3rd floor walk-up'
params.cars: 1-3 x {driver, car, kind: hatch|wagon|truck, fits: 0 no|1 roof|2 bed, seats}
params.crew: how many people the free counts are out of
